title: automate-kms-hsm-and-tls-rotation-vault-sealed-secrets
author: Jordan Hayes
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require automated, auditable key and certificate management that integrates with both cloud KMS and on-prem HSMs. This PR adds Terraform modules, Helm chart updates, installer CLI flags, and upgrade/rollback hooks to enable automated TLS rotation, KMS/HSM binding for service keys, and optional sealed-secrets/Vault integration for secret delivery to the cluster.

What this PR does:
- Adds a reusable Terraform module (modules/kms_hsm) that provisions KMS key resources (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) and optional HSM bindings (PKCS#11 interface) for on-prem customers. Module supports BYOK import and key rotation policy metadata.
- Extends the Helm chart (charts/private-installer) with templates for cert-manager integration, automatic Certificate resources for internal services, and a new rbac + job that performs rolling TLS certificate rotation with pre/post hooks.
- Adds a sealed-secrets + vault-connector optional mode that allows operator-approved secret delivery; installer can render sealed secrets from Vault using an admin token during install/upgrade.
- Implements an upgrade hook and rollback plan: a two-phase rotation controller that can pre-generate key pairs, validate new cert chains against live endpoints, perform a rolling swap, and rollback to previous certs if probes fail.
- CLI and installer changes: new flags --kms-provider/--hsm-config, --rotation-policy, and --sealed-secrets-mode (off/manual/auto). The installer produces a structured rotation plan that is logged and can be audited.
- E2E tests and CI: adds integration tests for TLS rotation in the perf-canary harness and a smoke test for Vault -> sealed-secrets flow.
- Docs: updates private-installer/README and upgrades.md with operational guidance and rollback steps.

Testing and rollout:
- Unit + integration tests run in CI (see ci_checks). Manual staging rollout performed to an on-prem cluster with Thales Luna HSM emulation. Confirmed zero 5xx and <50ms median %ile latency impact for control plane during rotation.

Notes and constraints:
- HSM integration requires customer-provided PKCS#11 config and network access; installer will not auto-provision hardware.
- BYOK import requires KMS provider permissions; documented in docs/ops/keys.md.

Related: ENG-5921 (KMS backend design), SUP-2102 (customer support case for cert rotation incidents).
